Recording controls at the top, and a cleaner window on Mac.

**Windows:** `Deviload-2.6.3-setup.exe`, or accept the update prompt in the app.

**Mac (test build):** accept the update prompt, or take `Deviload-2.6.3-macos-test.zip`, move it to Applications and run `xattr -cr /Applications/Deviload.app` once.

**Linux (x86_64):** `Deviload-2.6.3-amd64.deb` or `Deviload-2.6.3-x86_64.AppImage`; the AppImage updates itself.

What's new

- While a live stream is recording, the panel at the top has its buttons too: stop the recording, change its length limit or open its log without scrolling to the card
- Stopping a recording before the stream sent anything now ends the task as cancelled instead of a yt-dlp error, and a daily recording still comes back the next day
- Mac: the grey title bar is gone; the window buttons sit on the dark sidebar and the strip on top moves the window
- Every drop-down has the same arrow on Windows, Mac and Linux

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.6.2...v2.6.3
